praise.title: Praise
praise.feel: High energy; quicker speeds, pushes/pulls. Anticipate jumping, active crowd, vocalist movement — favor front rows, push aisles. Opens on EG riff; quieter/stirring verses, bigger choruses, back down for verses 3–4. Bridges build to a breakdown (EG riff) into an all-in jam through the end. Aggressive EG in the instrumental.

wild rushing wind.title: Wild Rushing Wind
wild rushing wind.feel: Moderate intensity; big sweeping/swaying feel, "dawn breaking" corporate anthem. Gently stirring open, picks up (still stirring) into pre-chorus, breakdown in chorus, chorus 2 all-in. Bridge drops back to quieter stirring, builds into an all-out ending, then pulls way down small and quiet at the close. Crowd focus and vocalist profiles in the big moments.
wild rushing wind.progression: Intro (EG) → Verse 1 (Keys) → Verse 2 → Pre-Chorus → Chorus Breakdown (Keys) → Vamp → Pre-Chorus → Chorus All In (EG) → Vamp → Bridge (Crowd) → Bridge → Bridge → Tag 1 → Tag 1 → Tag 1 → Vamp → Chorus All In → Tag 2 Breakdown → Chorus → Ending

Breakdowns drop soft but keep building/stirring. Sick riff at the end of the first bridge. Montage energy — lots happening at once, like a movie sequence.

Opens soft on piano and strings, layers in guitars and drums through the chorus. Instrumental drops dynamics for Communion (tracks pulled back so the room's dynamics are controlled live). Bridges build on a kick pulse into big, full-groove refrains and choruses, then pull back to piano and strings for a soft close.
